item.title: By: Dian Reed
item.dc:creator: Dian Reed
item.description: Such a wise observation: "The only silver lining here lies in how attending the school of life gradually forces us to see how frequently life turns out differently than we thought. That sobers us to the humble, albeit often subconscious, truth: I don’t really know; I feel what I feel, and thoughts just bubble up from the depth." Now if only that subconscious truth could be conscious more often!
